_comment: Engine table: crimes are the same in every city (docs/contracts/law-data.md). severity 1-5 is compared with an agency's minPursuitSeverity; heat is the level a crime raises the heat to, at least; witnessRadius is how far a witness can SEE it (with a clear line) and hearRadius, when there is one, how far a witness HEARS it (no line needed; the weapon's hearM scales it), both in metres. points is what a reported crime adds to the run of heat (repeated crimes reach heat 2, sustained violence heat 3: rules.escalation), violent marks the ones that count toward that violence total. 'rules' holds the tunables of the heat model: how witnesses call (chance, delay, giving up), the escalation thresholds, the cooldown seconds out of sight by heat level, how far the police see, and the search area that grows from the last known position. Heat 4 and up cools slowly and is slowed further while the search is on top of you (data/police.json).
